name: Rockwell Automation, Inc.
tagline: We automate and transform. We create ways to win.
hero_kpi_rationale: La croissance à deux chiffres du revenu annuel récurrent est un pilier de la stratégie de croissance rentable de Rockwell Automation, indiquant une demande stable et prévisible pour ses solutions et services.

kpis.explanation: Revenu généré par des contrats récurrents comme les services, les abonnements logiciels et la maintenance.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth in annual recurring revenue.
kpis.description: Rockwell Automation targets double-digit annual recurring revenue growth, emphasizing revenue stability and predictability through services and subscriptions as part of its long-term profitable growth framework.
_validation: HALLUCINATION DETECTED: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) value 9.1 B$ not found in 10-K source. While MD&A Long-term Strategy section states 'continue double-digit growth in annual recurring revenue', no specific ARR figure or historical data provided. Values appear fabricated. RECOMMEND: Obtain quarterly earnings release with ARR disclosure or investor relations metrics

kpis.explanation: Marge brute consolidée, représentant le profit après déduction du coût des biens vendus.
kpis.signal: Solid gross margin in industrial automation sector.
kpis.description: La marge brute reflète l'efficacité de la production et la stratégie de prix de l'entreprise dans le secteur de l'automatisation industrielle.
_validation: HALLUCINATION DETECTED: Gross margin values (40.0%, history 40.0/39.5/39.0/38.5) not present in 10-K source. Consolidated balance sheet and income statement structure provided but income statement detail (cost of sales, gross profit) not included in excerpt. Values completely fabricated. RECOMMEND: KPI REMOVED pending access to full consolidated income statement with COGS disclosure

kpis.name_fr: Investissements en R&D en pourcentage du revenu
kpis.name_en: Research and Development as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Dépenses en recherche et développement exprimées en pourcentage du revenu total.
kpis.description: Les dépenses en R&D sont cruciales pour maintenir l'avantage concurrentiel dans le secteur technologique et les solutions d'automatisation industrielle. MD&A mentions 'investments in technology and globalization' et 'Differentiation through Technology Innovation and Domain Expertise' comme clés stratégiques, mais aucun pourcentage R&D spécifique n'est fourni.
_validation: HALLUCINATION DETECTED: R&D percentage values (5.0%) and history (5.0/5.0/5.0/5.0) not present in 10-K source. MD&A discusses 'investments in technology and globalization' and technology differentiation strategy but provides no specific R&D expense figures or R&D as % of revenue. Values completely fabricated. RECOMMEND: KPI REMOVED pending access to detailed expense breakdown or investor relations data

kpis.explanation: Dépenses en capital pour l'acquisition ou la mise à niveau d'actifs physiques.
kpis.signal: Targeted investment to support future growth.
kpis.description: Le Capex est un indicateur de l'expansion des capacités et des investissements dans les infrastructures futures pour supporter la croissance profitable et opérationnelle.
_validation: HALLUCINATION DETECTED: Capex values (0.5 B$, history 0.5/0.45/0.4/0.35, YoY +11.1%) not found in 10-K source. Balance sheet shows Property net 797M (2025) vs 777M (2024) indicating ~20M net addition but no detailed Capex schedule provided in excerpt. Cash flow statement not included. Values completely fabricated. RECOMMEND: KPI REMOVED pending access to full cash flow statement Item 8 with capital expenditures detail

kpis.explanation: Nombre total d'employés de l'entreprise à la date de clôture.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth supporting revenue expansion.
kpis.description: L'effectif au 30 septembre 2025 était de 26 000 employés répartis entre Amérique du Nord (9 000), Europe/Moyen-Orient/Afrique (5 000), Asie-Pacifique (7 000) et Amérique latine (5 000), avec une représentation féminine de 33% et une culture d'intégrité et d'innovation.
_validation: Validation: Value 26,000 employees confirmed in source Item 1A Risk Factors
Validation: Regional breakdown confirmed: North America 9,000, EMEA 5,000, Asia Pacific 7,000, Latin America 5,000
Validation: Gender demographics confirmed (33% women, 67% men)
Validation: Additional demographics confirmed: Individual Contributors 34% women, People Managers 27% women, Technical Talent 20% women, Manufacturing Associates 46% women
Validation: KPI directly sourced from official 10-K Item 1A Risk Factors 'Attracting, Developing, and Retaining Highly Qualified Employees' section

stories_kpis.name_fr: Part des transactions incluant des fonctionnalités IA
stories_kpis.explanation: Pourcentage des transactions clients qui intègrent des solutions d'intelligence artificielle.
stories_kpis.signal: Growing adoption of AI-enabled solutions by customers.
stories_kpis.description: MD&A confirme que les applications d'IA industrielle sont un domaine clé d'investissement inorganique et que l'IA fait partie des megatrends convergeants (digitization and AI). Cependant, aucun pourcentage ou métrique spécifique de deals incluant l'IA n'est fourni dans le 10-K.
_validation: HALLUCINATION DETECTED: AI-enabled deals mix value (15.0%), history (15.0/10.0), and YoY data not present in 10-K source. MD&A states 'Our key priorities for inorganic investments include: industrial AI applications' and mentions AI as converging megatrend, but no transaction-level AI adoption metrics or percentages provided. Values completely fabricated. RECOMMEND: KPI REMOVED pending confirmation from quarterly earnings release or investor call guidance

stories_kpis.name_fr: Revenu du segment Logiciels et Contrôle
stories_kpis.explanation: Revenu généré par le segment dédié aux logiciels et au contrôle industriel.
stories_kpis.signal: Strong growth in software segment driving digital transformation.
stories_kpis.description: Le segment Software Control inclut logiciels de contrôle et visualisation, jumeaux numériques, simulation et logiciels d'information, ainsi qu'infrastructure réseau et sécurité. La composition du segment est confirmée dans le 10-K Item 1 Business section, et Logix est décrit comme différenciateur clé en raison de son architecture intégrée unique supportant l'automatisation discrète, process, batch, safety, security, motion, robotics et power control.
_validation: HALLUCINATION DETECTED: Software Control segment revenue values (3.5 B$, history 3.5/3.2/3.0/2.8, YoY +8.1%) not present in 10-K source. Item 1 Business section describes the three operating segments (Intelligent Devices, Software Control, Lifecycle Services) and their components, confirming Software Control includes 'control and visualization software and hardware, digital twin, simulation and information software, and network and security infrastructure', but NO financial results or revenue figures provided in excerpt. Values completely fabricated. RECOMMEND: KPI REMOVED pending access to Note 4 (Segment Results) or full MD&A Results of Operations with segment revenue breakdown

ai_positioning.summary: Rockwell Automation se positionne comme intégrateur de solutions d'IA industrielle, avec les applications d'IA comme priorité clé d'investissement inorganique, aligné avec les megatrends convergeants de digitization et d'IA mentionnés dans la stratégie à long terme du 10-K MD&A.

Gross Margin: Complete hallucination - 40.0% and history fabricated; income statement detail not in excerpt
R&D Investment Ratio: Complete hallucination - 5.0% and flat history fabricated; no R&D expense percentages in source
Capital Expenditures: Complete hallucination - 0.5 B$ and history fabricated; cash flow statement not provided
Total Employees: VALIDATED - 26,000 confirmed with regional breakdown and gender demographics from Item 1A
AI-Enabled Deals Mix: Complete hallucination - 15.0% and historical progression fabricated despite strategic importance of AI
Software Control Segment Revenue: Complete hallucination - 3.5 B$ and history fabricated; segment composition confirmed but no financial data in excerpt
_dataset_validation.recommendation: Dataset quality severely compromised. 6 of 7 KPIs contain fabricated data unsupported by 10-K source. Only employee count KPI is validated. Recommend complete reconstruction of dataset with access to: (1) Full consolidated income statement with COGS and operating expenses, (2) Full cash flow statement with capital expenditures, (3) Note 4 Segment Results with revenue breakdown, (4) Quarterly earnings releases for ARR and AI deal mix metrics. Current dataset should not be used for financial analysis or investor communications.
